name: FLARE
desc: Forward-Looking Active Retrieval. Uses model's low-confidence token predictions as signal to anticipate future information needs and retrieve proactively. Retrieves only when token probability falls below threshold; generator stays frozen.

name: Generative Semantic Workspace (GSW)
desc: Replaces chunk-retrieval with neuro-inspired generative memory. Operator maps observations to intermediate semantic structures; Reconciler integrates them into a persistent workspace with temporal/spatial/logical coherence. Targets 100k–1M-token corpora.
deployment: not applicable — not a deployable product

name: GraphRAFT
desc: Retrieval-augmented fine-tuning for knowledge graphs on graph databases.
deployment: not applicable — not a deployable product

name: GraphRAG (Microsoft)
desc: Modular graph-based RAG. Leiden community detection over knowledge graph; community summaries at multiple levels. DRIFT Search hybrid (Oct 2024).

name: HiRAG
desc: Multi-layer knowledge graph: higher layers hold coarse summary entities improving connectivity between similar lower-layer entities (HiIndex). HiRetrieval traverses across granularity levels.
deployment: not applicable — not a deployable product

name: HippoRAG / HippoRAG2
desc: Hippocampus-inspired RAG. LLMs + knowledge graphs + Personalized PageRank to mimic neocortex/hippocampus roles. NeurIPS 2024.

name: HippoRAG 2
desc: OSU follow-on to HippoRAG — adds online updates, recall-precision tradeoff calibration, and multi-hop reasoning improvements.

name: HyDE
desc: LLM generates a hypothetical answer document; embeds that instead of the query. Closes the query-document semantic gap for retrieval. arxiv 2212.10496.

name: ITER-RETGEN
desc: Uses model's generated output as a rich context signal for the next retrieval round rather than just the original query. Processes all retrieved knowledge as a whole, preserving generation flexibility.

name: KAG
desc: Knowledge-Augmented Generation. LLM-friendly KG representation + mutual indexing between KGs and raw chunks + logical-form-guided hybrid reasoning. Handles numerical / temporal / multi-hop chains that vector similarity misses.

name: LazyGraphRAG
desc: Performs minimal up-front indexing; defers LLM use until query time. Being integrated into the main GraphRAG library.

name: LightRAG
desc: Hong Kong U graph-RAG variant — dual-level retrieval (local + global) over an entity-relation graph built incrementally from corpus updates.

name: LightRAG
desc: Entity-relationship graph + broader-theme retrieval. Incremental update support. Integrates with RAG-Anything for multimodal docs.

name: LongRAG
desc: Groups related Wikipedia documents into 4K-token units. Reduces NQ corpus 22M→600K units, HotpotQA 5M→500K. Hands longer passages to a long-context reader (GPT-4o).

name: MemoRAG
desc: RAG variant with a long-context global memory model that drafts answer clues used to guide passage retrieval — improves recall in noisy multi-hop QA.

name: Multi-Head RAG (MHRAG)
desc: Uses transformer multi-head attention activations (not decoder-layer embeddings) as retrieval keys, yielding multi-aspect embeddings that independently capture different semantic facets for heterogeneous queries.

name: PathRAG
desc: Retrieves over an indexed graph by pruning candidate relational paths — reduces noise in graph-RAG vs flat path expansion.

name: PathRAG
desc: Retrieves key relational paths from knowledge graph; flow-based pruning + reliability scoring; path-based prompting. Outperforms baselines on six datasets. arxiv Feb 2025.

name: RAFT
desc: UC Berkeley. Trains the model to ignore distractor documents and quote the relevant text in chain-of-thought.

name: RAPTOR
desc: Stanford recursive-summarisation tree over the corpus — clusters and summarises documents into a hierarchical index; retrieves at multiple levels. ICLR 2024.

name: RAPTOR
desc: Recursively embeds, clusters, and summarises chunks into a tree of abstractions. Retrieval traverses the tree at query time. ICLR 2024.

name: REALM
desc: Foundational paper. Augments LM pre-training with a latent knowledge retriever — model retrieves and attends over Wikipedia-scale corpus during pre-training, fine-tuning, and inference. Backprop through retrieval over millions of documents. Guu et al., Google, ICML 2020.

name: RETRO
desc: DeepMind. Retrieval-Enhanced Transformer with chunked cross-attention over a 2T-token retrieval database. Frozen BERT retriever + differentiable encoder.
license: not applicable — no official DeepMind code (unofficial lucidrains/RETRO-pytorch

name: RouteRAG
desc: End-to-end RL-trained RAG. Token-level policy chooses when to retrieve and which mode (text / KG / hybrid via RRF). Two-stage Group-Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO). No public repo at time of writing.
deployment: not applicable — not a deployable product

name: Self-RAG
desc: Trains an LLM end-to-end to emit reflection tokens that decide whether to retrieve, assess passage relevance, and critique output quality — all within a single model.

name: Speculative RAG
desc: Smaller distilled specialist generates multiple RAG drafts in parallel from distinct document subsets. Larger generalist verifies in a single pass. Subsets formed by content-similarity clustering to minimise redundancy.
deployment: not applicable — not a deployable product

name: StructRAG
desc: Identifies optimal structure (table, catalog, algorithm, graph) per task; converts source documents into that structure at inference time and reasons over the structured form. Motivated by cognitive theories of human knowledge conversion.

name: TC-RAG
desc: Frames RAG as Turing-complete with explicit monitored state variables, enabling adaptive retrieval halting and convergence control. Medical-LLM case study.

name: WeKnow-RAG
desc: Domain KGs + multi-stage web-page retrieval (sparse + dense) + LLM self-assessment of trustworthiness before finalising answer.
deployment: not applicable — not a deployable product

name: m_flow (M-Flow)
desc: Cognitive memory engine modelled on biology that presents itself as a new paradigm for graph RAG for agents. Traction: ~4.5k stars; #13 on GitHub agent-memory topic

name: ASAPP GenerativeAgent
desc: Treats memory as first-class architecture. Captures the digital footprint of every interaction; retrieves preference and history at engagement time. Public example: airline knowing a frequent flyer wants aisle seats with her son — preference-aware, not just history-lookup.

name: Abridge
desc: Clinician-assist ambient documentation. Source mapping: every AI-generated summary element traced back to the source utterance. Audit-and-trust layer over episodic memory. Built on proprietary 1.5M+ medical-encounter dataset.

name: BenevolentAI
desc: Taken private: merged into Osaka Holdings (renamed BenevolentAI S.A.) and delisted from Euronext Amsterdam 2025-03-13. Target identification / drug repurposing / mechanism tracing. 85+ data sources, petabyte-scale, rebuilt every few weeks. Wet-lab results re-enter the graph and shift downstream predictions — institutional experimental memory closing a feedback loop.

name: Causaly
desc: Agentic AI platform for life sciences: orchestrated scientific agents over a curated biomedical knowledge graph (plus Bio Graph and Pipeline Graph), an evidence-retrieval system and an enterprise data fabric over literature, trials and patents.

name: Character.ai
desc: Chat Memories (user-defined facts), auto-memories for c.ai+ subscribers, pinned memories, in-context retention. Latest chat models PipSqueak 3 and ShortSqueak (Sep 2026). On 2026-10-12 the company announced a voluntary Chapter 11 process for a court-supervised sale of all or substantially all assets (sale expected late Nov/early Dec 2026); the platform keeps running meanwhile and would be wound do

name: Charisma.ai
desc: No-code interactive narrative platform. Characters track what they know, when they were lied to, what they misremember; story state changes downstream behaviour. Characters can deliberately lie / misremember and track when players have lied.

name: ChatGPT Study Mode
desc: Activates a Socratic interaction style — guiding questions, scaffolded concepts, knowledge checks rather than direct answers. With ChatGPT Memory enabled, persists learning goals and facts across sessions. Memory is not study-mode-specific; it is the same general ChatGPT Memory, so personalization depth depends on whether the user has memory enabled and populated.
pricing: Available on Free, Go ($8/mo), Plus ($20/mo), Pro ($200/mo), Team/Business

name: Clio Duo / Manage AI
desc: SMB law firms. AI embedded in practice management; pulls full matter overviews — WIP, billing, documents, communications — as context. Memory is the PMS data; no separately persisted cross-matter layer. Renamed Manage AI at ClioCon 2025.
deployment: Cloud SaaS only (runs entirely in Clio's cloud infrastructure)
pricing: from $49/user/mo (third-party listing; AI add-on pricing not public)

name: CoCounsel Legal (Thomson Reuters)
desc: Next-gen release (Aug 2026, built on Claude Agent SDK) is fully agentic and adds per-matter Workspaces that keep firm documents and precedents as context across matters and teams, plus Brief Builder, a Word drafting agent and Deep Research Verify.
deployment: Managed SaaS; GA in US, Canada/UK/Australia slated for later 2026

name: Cognigy (now NiCE Cognigy)
desc: Acquired by NiCE (closed 2025-09-08); continues as NiCE Cognigy, standalone and inside CXone Mpower. Enterprise contact centre (voice + chat). Short-term covers current session; long-term persists across sessions and is shared by every agent a customer might encounter. Most explicitly engineered memory model in the segment.
type: Two-tier short + long-term, shared across agents

name: Convai (Mimir)
desc: Mimir hierarchical memory: short-term (verbatim), medium-term (summaries + emotion), long-term (cross-session). Scene awareness layer adds in-engine perception. Unity + Unreal SDKs with real-time voice + lipsync.
pricing: Credit-based subscriptions (~1,000 credits per $); e.g. Professional $99/mo = 99k credits; full tier list not retrievable

name: Cresta
desc: Sales + contact centre. Customer history feeds real-time guidance and coaching. Memory survives handoffs between AI agent, human agent, and channels — but leans on CRM as the primary store.

name: Decagon
desc: Autonomous support agents resolving end-to-end (refunds, cancellations). Channel-agnostic memory: chat → call carries prior context. Agents recognise returning customers and recall prior issues.

name: DeepScribe
desc: Specialty-care ambient scribe (oncology focus). Pulls forward prior notes with precise dates; synthesises interval history (what changed since last visit); auto-populates disease-status and treatment-plan context.

name: Duolingo Max
desc: Adds GPT-4-powered Roleplay (character conversations, with cross-call memory for "Lily") and Explain My Answer on top of Duolingo's existing spaced-repetition engine, which tracks per-word and per-skill mastery state across all sessions.

name: ELSA Speak
desc: Persistent pronunciation profile per user, tracking which sounds, words, and patterns the learner consistently mispronounces. Self-evolving model re-evaluates and updates the profile as the learner improves. Competitive moat is a proprietary non-native accent training dataset, not a general LLM.
pricing: Free + paid individual plans; Business (50+ learners) and Schools (21+) custom pricing

name: Elicit
desc: Systematic literature review + data extraction + meta-analysis. Every extracted claim anchored to its exact source sentence; Notebook persists paper collections across projects. Research Agents (Dec 2025) carry evidence forward across review stages.
pricing: Basic free; Pro $49/user/mo; Scale $169/user/mo; Enterprise custom (annual billing; page showed conflicting variants incl. Plus $11 / Pro $39 / Scale $89)

name: Eve — Shared Firm Knowledge + Auditor
desc: Plaintiff-law AI operating layer (EveOS) spanning intake, case work, research and firm analytics; its Auditor module reviews open matters for missed case value. The firm-wide knowledge store is no longer a named module on the homepage.
type: Firm-level store + nightly autonomous case auditor

name: Figure Helix
desc: Humanoid VLA model: a 7B VLM (System 2, 7–9 Hz) continuously updates a shared latent vector of behavioral intent that an 80M visuomotor policy (System 1, 200 Hz) consumes alongside the latest observation; runs onboard Figure robots.
deployment: Managed hardware deployment (robots at partner sites)

name: Filevine LOIS
desc: Embedded in case-management platform. Holds full scope of every matter — deadlines, billing, discovery, communications, negotiation history — as live context for every query. Case data is the context, not a separate retrieval corpus.
pricing: Free LOIS Explore tier (research/drafting, no card) + 90-day free trial; paid/enterprise pricing via sales
type: Whole-matter context as live LLM input

name: FutureHouse
desc: Full autonomous-scientist loop. Owl agent surfaces prior work so downstream agents don't re-derive known results. WikiCrow produced cited factsheets for 15,616 previously undocumented human genes; Phoenix uses accumulated experiment context to plan chemistry work.

name: GWM (Gaussian World Models)
desc: Encodes scene into 3D Gaussian Splat representations via 3D VAE; latent Diffusion Transformer predicts future Gaussian Splat states conditioned on robot actions. 3D scene representation persists across time steps as structural scene memory rather than flat features.
